test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.

The people affected with ____________ are vulnerable to other infections as well.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"pneumonia"** is a medical condition involving inflammation of the lungs, often caused by infection.
 
• **​"Pneumonia" **is correctly spelled and commonly used in medical contexts to describe lung infections.
